structural_development.rationale: Pre is a single word ('heels'). Post elaborates the offering into multiple descriptors ('comfortable and stylish heels/other footwear like heeled boots/low-mid heels'), adding qualitative attributes and expanding the product range with two additional heeled-footwear categories. This is more than cosmetic but confined to one sentence with limited elaboration.

semantic_events.rationale: The core product (heels) is retained and supplemented with two qualitative descriptors (comfortable, stylish) within the same product frame. POST does not shift what heels refers to; it adds attribute-level detail. Same conceptual frame persists.

The pre concept 'heels' is broadened to include another heeled-footwear sub-type (heeled boots) alongside the original. Heels as a category now encompasses both the original offering and heeled boots. Heeled boots are not a subset of the pre 'heels' (boots are a different footwear silhouette), so this is expansion of the offering, not narrowing of the original.

The pre 'heels' is broadened to include a heel-height specification (low-mid heels) as an additional offering alongside the original general heels. This expands the product line into a specified heel-height variant.
